input.command:
set -e
CONF=/etc/postgresql/14/main/postgresql.conf
HBA=/etc/postgresql/14/main/pg_hba.conf
sed -i "s/^#listen_addresses = 'localhost'.*/listen_addresses = '*'/" "$CONF"
sed -i "s/^local   all             all                                     peer/local   all             all                                     trust/" "$HBA"
pg_ctlcluster 14 main start || (sleep 2; pg_ctlcluster 14 main start)
sleep 2
su postgres -c "psql -p 5433 -tAc 'select version()'"
echo "--- port ---"; grep -nE "^port|^listen_addresses" "$CONF"; grep -nE "^local   all             all" "$HBA"
